content: The Tamhīd is published as al-Tamhīd fī Sharḥ Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd, ed. Ḥasan al-Ramaḍānī al-Khurasānī (Beirut 2003), and as Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid, ed. Sayyid Jalāl al-Dīn Āshtiyānī (Tehran 1976; reprinted 1981, 2002); a lithograph was first printed by Shaykh Aḥmad Shīrāzī (Tehran 1897/1315), and ʿAbd Allāh Javādī-Āmulī wrote a commentary, Taḥrīr-i Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid (1993).
